strategies:
name: Two customer replicas
description: Scale the customer service out behind its load balancer. Each replica has its own database connection, so the lock is shared by half the traffic.
changes:
  - service: customer
    replicas: 2
name: Everything on Graviton
description: Move every container to Arm (Fargate Graviton). Same vCPU and memory, about 20% cheaper.
changes:
  - service: frontend
    arch: arm
  - service: customer
    arch: arm
  - service: driver
    arch: arm
  - service: route
    arch: arm
  - service: customer-lb
    arch: arm
name: Autoscale customer on CPU
description: Target-tracking at 60% CPU, 1–4 replicas. The customer service waits on a lock, not on CPU — does CPU autoscaling ever react?
changes:
  - service: customer
    autoscale: { min: 1, max: 4, targetCpu: 0.6, warmupS: 20, cooldownS: 120 }
name: Clients retry twice, no budget
description: Clients re-send failed requests up to two times. Retries add load exactly when the system is already overloaded.
changes:
  - endpoint: "*"
    retries: { attempts: 2 }
